title: Design Studio Selections Selection Sheet Terms: Adding, Pricing and Removing Option Lines
content:
These terms govern the option lines on a Design Studio Selections file: their price, the periods in which they may be added or removed, and the credit given when they are removed.

**Price at which options are added.** The clause under which options are added to the file at the price quoted at the appointment is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Price protection.** A quoted option price is honored only when the line is added within the package's price protection days, counted in calendar days after the appointment at which it was quoted. Counting starts the day after the appointment date and the last counted day is included. The appointment date is the date of that appointment's entry on the design ledger. The clause under which, after that period, the current studio price applies is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**When lines may change.** Option lines are added or removed only while the file status is in selection or structural closed, as shown on that file's record. Structural, electrical and plumbing lines are added or removed only while the file is in selection, unless the package permits structural changes after construction start; finish lines (cabinetry, countertops, flooring, appliances, exterior) also while the file is structural closed.

| File status | Structural, electrical, plumbing lines | Finish lines |
|---|---|---|
| In selection | May be added or removed | May be added or removed |
| Structural closed | Only where the package permits structural changes after construction start | May be added or removed |
| Awaiting appointment, finalized, delivered, cancelled | Not added or removed | Not added or removed |

**Included levels.** Lines at or below the package's included levels (cabinet level, countertop level, flooring level, the upgraded appliance package and the smart home package where included) carry no price.

**Buyer portal.** Finish lines may be selected through the buyer portal only where the package permits portal selection and the file's portal total stays within the package's portal selection cap. The portal total is, over the life of the file, the prices of the lines selected through the portal less the removal credits of those lines.

**Removal credit.** A removed line is credited at the package's in-selection removal credit percent of its price while the file is in selection, and at the package's after-structural-close removal credit percent after structural close, rounded half up to the cent.

**Change orders.** The clause under which, after the first appointment, every addition or removal is written under a change order is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)**

- A line priced 2345.67 removed after structural close on a package crediting 60 percent: 2345.67 multiplied by 60 percent is 1407.402, credited as 1407.40.
- The same line removed while the file is in selection on a package crediting 100 percent is credited 2345.67.
- A price quoted at an appointment held on 2026-04-10, under a package with 30 price protection days: day 1 is 2026-04-11 and day 30 is 2026-05-10. Added on 2026-05-10, the quoted price is honored; added on 2026-05-11, it is not.

superseded_clauses: Options are added to the file at the price quoted at the appointment.
after that the current studio price applies.
After the first appointment, every addition or removal is written under a change order.
